records.name: Toiletten Shopping Arena
records.description_rewritten: Toilets at Shopping Arena Salzburg appear on a cruising-directory city index. Shopping Arena is a two-building shopping complex connected by an underground passage. Its public existence and daytime shopping hours are verifiable; the exact toilets named in the directory and any current cruising use are unconfirmed.
records.location: Shopping Arena, Alpenstraße 107, 5020 Salzburg; publicly accessed privately managed property.
records.access_notes: Shopping centre generally Mon–Fri 09:00–19:00, Sat 09:00–18:00; individual retailers vary and no toilet-specific hours established.

records.name: Asfinag Raststation-Herzogenburg
records.description_rewritten: An ASFINAG motorway rest-area lead labelled Herzogenburg near Sankt Pölten. Official motorway camera information places a Herzogenburg rest stop on the S33 at km 15.65 in the direction of St. Pölten. The user-supplied directory's name does not establish which side or facility is intended, and the cruising claim remains undated.
records.location: S33 Kremser Schnellstraße near Herzogenburg, Lower Austria; verify the exact carriageway and site before identifying an entrance.
records.access_notes: Motorway rest area; normal parking is for a travel break; rest areas and leased service stations have different management arrangements.

records.access_notes: Building closed 01:00–06:00 according to centre FAQ. Core shops typically Mon–Fri 09:00–20:00, Sat 09:00–18:00; retail, restaurant and WC hours differ.

records.name: Wienerberg
records.description_rewritten: Recreation and naturist area at the Wienerberg park in Vienna-Favoriten. Squirt's archived entry and gay-szene.net independently associate the northwest pond reedbed with cruising, distinct from the open naturist section. The archived messages support historical accounts, not contemporary attendance.
records.location: Wienerbergteich northwest shore, 1100 Vienna; source notes access via Triester Straße/Hertha-Firnberg-Straße, verify permitted park routes.
records.access_notes: Outdoor public park with naturist area nearby; park, reedbed and wildlife-protection rules need review.

records.name: Rathauspark
records.description_rewritten: Historic gay cruising location in the southern, parliament-facing half of Vienna's Rathauspark. Two independent cruising directories and a Squirt archive describe the same park, and Wien Museum documented it in its 2016 exhibition. Reports are historical and do not prove recent attendance; city events frequently occupy Rathausplatz and change conditions.
records.location: Rathauspark southern section toward Parliament, 1010 Vienna; note Squirt's 'Dr Karl Lueger Ring' is outdated street naming.
records.access_notes: Public park and adjacent civic event grounds; access and security conditions can change with events, and public sex is not assumed permitted.
